full marks to everyone who planned and took part in the 60-year diamond anniversary celebration mass of st paul’s national school, walshestown on sunday week last. it was a beautiful mass in ss peter & paul’s church and a wonderful gathering afterwards in the school, with the blessing of the classrooms and of the whole building, including the new additions of recent years. well done indeed to the principal, miss swinburne and staff, to the children, the parents, the parents’ council, the board of management, parishioners and former teachers and pupils - amongst them the three 6" class pupils of 1965 - michael stanley, anthony morgan, terry duffy - who made a little history in being asked by the principal, mr ward (not liking the ‘new-fangled’ blackboards attached to the classrooms’ walls) to carry a big blackboard and easel from the old walshestown school at murray’s cross to the new st paul’s - but promptly having to carry them back again to the old school at the insistence of the parish priest, fr corry! the picture above shows the staff and chaplain at the cutting of the diamond celebratory cake. comhghairdeas le gach duine. november dead lists november dead list sheets and envelopes are now available in all churches. you are invited to take an envelope for the list and write down all your family deceased and others
